agent_config.run_facts:
Dataset: real OKX BTCUSDT perpetual-futures trades. A session is a UTC day (00:00 to 24:00 UTC); the market trades continuously, with no close, no holidays and no overnight gap, so `session` boundaries are a calendar convention, not a market event. Every trade carries its aggressor side, so `unknown_volume` is always zero, 960 scored sessions on the pre-registered train split.

Fill model: book-queue-pessimistic -- a fill requires a trade strictly through your limit, so you pay the spread on every entry and exit.

Sizes are integer lots of 0.0001 BTC: `ctx.buy(1)` is 0.0001 BTC, and P&L is the price move in USD times lots, so one lot earns 0.0001 USD per $1 the price moves. Commission: 5 basis points of notional per side (0.10% a round trip), charged on every fill: a round trip must move the price 0.10% just to break even -- $30 at $30,000, $100 at $100,000 -- so high turnover is very expensive here. Holding a position through a funding settlement (00:00, 08:00, 16:00 UTC) pays the funding rate on its notional when long and receives it when short (the reverse when the rate is negative). Returns are scored relative to each session's opening price, so a move of 1% counts the same in 2023 and in 2026.

Latency: 100,000,000 ns. Every order, modification and cancel reaches the market that long after your callback, and a resting order can still fill until its cancel arrives.

Action cap: 64 per session. History window: 512 bars.

record.note: Governed by docs/design/pre-registration.md. The model proposes one strategy at a time and edits the champion; the null is the sign-flip over round turns (section 3b), NOT the conditional null. Dataset 'crypto-btc-okx-book', train split. **No measured FWER applies to this configuration.** Task 57's 400-campaign figure and Task 59's power curve were measured on the NQ MVP configuration and are not transferable to a different dataset or a different null; quoting them here would be asserting a false-positive rate nobody has measured. Read an acceptance from this campaign as uncalibrated until its own null is tabulated.
record.stopping_rule: fixed budget; no early stop on any observed result
